name: Product Display
author: bilkisdev

sections.description:
Product Display is a powerful and user-friendly plugin designed to help you showcase your WooCommerce products in beautiful, customizable layouts.

With just a few clicks, you can display your products in various formats including Grid, List, Slider, Masonry, Flip, Card, Table, Gallery, CTA, Showcase, and Category Tabs all fully responsive and mobile-friendly.

Whether you’re building a modern online store or enhancing an existing one, this plugin helps improve customer engagement, browsing experience, and ultimately conversions.

Easily create stylish product showcases with an intuitive interface this plugin provides the flexibility you need.

Features

✅ Multiple Product Layouts – Grid, Masonry, Slider, Table, Gallery, Flip, Showcase, and more
✅ Built-in Wishlist – No third-party plugin required, supports AJAX-based instant saving
✅ Built-in Compare – Compare selected products easily and visually
✅ Quick View Popup – View product details in a modal without leaving the page
✅ Add to Cart – Enable customers to add products directly from the layout
✅ AJAX Product Filters – Make product search faster and easier
✅ Custom Styling Options – Adjust colors, typography, padding, and layout
✅ Shortcode Support – Display product layouts anywhere using shortcodes
✅ Elementor Integration – Dedicated Elementor widget with live preview in editor
✅ Responsive Design – 100% mobile-friendly and cross-browser compatible

Perfect for WooCommerce stores, Product Display gives you complete control over how your products are presented, improving user engagement and conversions.

External Libraries

This plugin utilizes the following third-party libraries:

  • Masonry.js: A JavaScript grid layout library (masonry)

    • Purpose: Masonry is used to create responsive, grid-based layouts for product displays.
    • Source: The full, unminified source code for Masonry is available at masonry.
    • License: MIT License

  • Slick.js: A responsive carousel jQuery plugin (slick)

    • Purpose: Used to create responsive product carousels and sliders.
    • Source: The full, unminified source code is available at kenwheeler.
    • License: MIT License

  • toastmaster.js: A lightweight, versatile modal and toast notification library that works seamlessly with vanilla JavaScript, React, Vue and other frameworks (toastmaster)

    • Purpose: Used to create toast, tag, notices.
    • Source: The full, unminified source code is available at toastmaster.
    • License: MIT License

The minified versions of these libraries are included in the plugin to optimize performance. The original, unminified source code is available through the links above. No data is sent to external services when using these libraries.

If you wish to modify these libraries or use the unminified versions:
1. Download the source code from the GitHub repositories linked above
2. Replace the minified files in the /assets/library/ directory with your modified or unminified versions
3. Clear your browser cache to ensure the changes take effect

Elementor Support

The Product Display plugin now includes Elementor integration, allowing you to easily add your product showcases to any Elementor-built page using a dedicated widget.

  • Dedicated Elementor Widget: Find “Product Display” widget in the Product Display category
  • Showcase Selection: Choose from all your saved product showcases
  • Override Settings: Customize specific settings without modifying the original showcase
  • Live Preview: See showcase details in the editor
  • Responsive Design: All showcases work perfectly with Elementor’s responsive features

How to Use

  1. Activate the Plugin: Go to Product Display in the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Choose a Layout: Select Grid, Masonry, or Table.
  3. Customize: Adjust settings to match your store’s design.
  4. Use Shortcodes: Insert [product_display layout="grid"] (or masonry/table) in posts or pages.
sections.installation:
1. Download & Upload: Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/product-display directory.
  2. Activate: Go to the ‘Plugins’ section in WordPress and activate Product Display.
  3. Configure: Navigate to Admin Dashboard > Product Display to customize settings.
sections.faq:
Q: Is this plugin compatible with HPOS in WooCommerce?

A: Yes! Product Display is fully compatible with both HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) and Legacy order systems.
